title: SkillEvalRubricResult
description: Structured output for qualitative rubric-based skill evaluation. A grader agent reviews the skill run output and generated artifacts, then returns this JSON. Use with --output-schema (Codex) or equivalent structured-output mechanism on other platforms.

run_id.description: Identifier for this eval run — matches the 'id' column from the prompts.csv row

overall_pass.description: True if all blocking checks passed and score >= 70. False otherwise.

score.description: Quality score 0–100. Each failed check deducts from 100: blocking failures deduct 15 points each, warning failures deduct 5 points each.

id.description: Check ID from the skill's rubric-items.json

notes.description: One sentence explaining why the check passed or failed. Quote specific output or file content when failing.
